# Ubuntu/Debian packages for MIB Studio Qt, one per line, grouped by
# `# section: <name>` headers. Consumers pick sections:
#   scripts/doctor.sh --sections base,backend[,frontend,desktop-shell,test-extras]
#   scripts/bootstrap.sh --sections ...
#   .devcontainer/Dockerfile and .github/actions/setup-linux-env (plan PR 3)
# Keep this the ONLY apt list in the repo; docs and workflows read it.
# Ubuntu 24.04 (Noble) is the reference image: its Qt 6.4.2 builds and passes
# the backend CTest suite; Conan Qt 6.7.3 remains the release toolchain.

# section: base
build-essential
cmake
ninja-build
pkg-config
git
curl
ca-certificates
python3
python3-pip
python3-venv

# section: backend
# linux-backend-only: mib_processing + mib_backend + CTest, no Qt.
libopencv-dev
libhdf5-dev
libspdlog-dev
libfmt-dev
nlohmann-json3-dev
libsqlite3-dev
libcurl4-openssl-dev
libssl-dev
libgl1-mesa-dev
libxkbcommon-dev

# section: frontend
# linux-system-release: Qt widgets/charts/serialport from apt, plus the
# runtime libraries the offscreen/xcb platform plugins load.
qt6-base-dev
qt6-charts-dev
qt6-serialport-dev
libegl1
libgl1
libxkbcommon0
libxcb-cursor0
libglib2.0-0t64   # Ubuntu 24.04 (time64) name; Debian/older Ubuntu: libglib2.0-0

# section: desktop-shell
# React + Tauri shell under desktop/ (Rust and Node come from
# rust-toolchain.toml / .nvmrc, not apt).
libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev
libgtk-3-dev
libsoup-3.0-dev
libjavascriptcoregtk-4.1-dev
webkit2gtk-driver
imagemagick  # Native dialog failure screenshots (root X11 window, not only webview).
xdotool
xvfb

# section: test-extras
# Conformance-input test in the backend/sanitizer lanes.
python3-numpy
